definition: Completed sqlx::query events inside the HTTP request scope. Includes authentication, transaction context/setup, application SQL, and COMMIT. Excludes SQLx's protocol-level BEGIN because SQLx 0.9 does not emit a query event for it. Detached usage bookkeeping is intentionally outside the foreground request scope.

baseline.method: Measured on the first D09-enabled isolated 64K current-build run. Exact values require 30 identical observations; upper bounds retain the reviewed default-safe variability allowance.

open.variability: Lexical anchor/fallback shape and semantic-ready coverage.

search.variability: Lexical anchor/fallback shape and semantic-ready coverage.

write.fixture: One new, single-chunk Markdown entry with semantic work queued.

checkpoint.variability: The baseline checkpoint has no explicit source_refs; the bounded 64-source probe is reported separately.

resume.variability: Checkpoint read, changes page, continuation exact lane, lexical fallback, and semantic-ready coverage.
